headline: Make Room for a Better Question
teaser: Capricorn, a closer look could reveal that an old plan needs a small adjustment, not a complete overhaul. Give conversations and commitments a little breathing room before deciding what deserves your energy.
opening: The Scorpio Sun and retrograde Mercury suggest a useful pause for Capricorn: look beneath the polished version of a plan and ask what it is really meant to accomplish. You may find that a commitment made sense once but now needs different terms. Rather than treating revision as a setback, consider it routine maintenance. Write down what still works, what feels unnecessarily complicated and who needs to be included in the conversation. You don't have to solve every loose end today; identifying the right question is progress enough.
relationships: With Venus retrograde in Libra as inspiration, revisit a pattern of keeping things agreeable at your own expense. If you've been saying yes automatically, try naming one preference before making the next shared plan. A simple “I'd rather stay in” or “Can we split that task?” gives someone a chance to respond to the real you, not just the accommodating version.
work: A project may benefit from a second pass, especially where instructions or responsibilities have become fuzzy. Before sending a proposal or handing off a task, check the assumptions with the people involved. Ask for a concrete example of what success looks like. That small clarification can make revision more useful and help you avoid polishing the wrong thing.
wellbeing: The Virgo Moon offers a reminder that care can be practical without becoming another performance target. Choose one small reset: clear a corner of your desk, make a satisfying meal or take a walk without tracking your pace. Notice whether the activity leaves you feeling more settled. If it starts to feel like another obligation, make it simpler.
takeaway: A thoughtful adjustment can honor your original goal while making it easier to live with.
